product.description: Monoprice™EZ™ Series Low Profile Tilt TV Wall Mount BracketEasy‑install UL® Certified tilt TV wall mount for most 37" ~ 80" TVsThis EZ™ Series Low Profile Tilt TV Wall Mount Bracket is designed to easily mount on the wall. It is meant for displays measuring up to 80"* and weighing up to 77 lbs. This slim mount features a simple tilting mechanism that deflects ambient glare away from the viewer's eyes. It has undergone extensive safety testing and has been certified by Underwriters Laboratories® (UL®), which ensures that it will perform safely and reliably. This thinner, agile mount is ideal for displays with side or bottom facing connections. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern, or vertical and horizontal distances between the mounting holes (in mm).This mount supports VESA patterns from 200x200 to 600x400 and supports TVs weighing up to 77 pounds.The screen size range is only a suggested approximation.Your TV is compatible as long as its VESA mounting pattern is between 200x200 to 600x400 and weighs no more than 77 pounds. INCLUDED ACCESSORIESTo make your mounting experience as simple and complete as possible, the Monoprice™ EZ™ Series includes a number of practical accessories and tools to make the job easier, including a carpenter's level, a cut‑out template, a Monoprice HDMI® cable, and Monoprice hook and loop cable ties. *The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations.
